name: Composite and reinforced thermoplastic pipe
principle: Spoolable pipe with a thermoplastic liner and fibre or steel reinforcement is laid from reels for gathering lines and produced water. The Shawcor/ Wikipedia sources could not be read, so no pressure ratings are on this card yet.
advantages: Long reels lay faster than welded steel
limitations: Pressure and temperature limits below steel
Not read in detail in this card

reference_plants.name: Hawtah field reinforced thermoplastic pipe flowlines (Saudi Aramco)

source.note: IQPC paper on Saudi Aramco RTP water-injection flowlines, read 2026-11-16

notes: Process provenance: construction and installation follow the supplier's description of API 15S line pipe - thermoplastic liner, helically wound reinforcement (polymer fibre, glass, aramid or steel strip) and outer cover, with end fittings as pressure-containing parts; installation covered at planning level (reel capacity, payout, minimum bend radius, pull forces, burial, terminations, repairs). No step-by-step procedure or qualification-test regime.

performance.metric: maximum design pressure, reinforced thermoplastic pipe
performance.basis: Up to 450 bar (6,527 psi) design pressure, service to 85 C (105 C for the high-temperature grade). Diameter range not stated on the page read.
